name: BraTS: Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation Benchmark
description: The Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) benchmark provides multi-institutional, multi-parametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI) scans of patients with diffuse gliomas, paired with expert neuroradiologist consensus delineations of enhancing tumor, peritumoral edema, and necrotic tumor core. Scans encompass four aligned structural modalities: pre- and post-contrast T1, T2, and T2-FLAIR. Safeguard notice: Curation and distribution restricted to medical algorithmic benchmarking and academic research; not approved for clinical diagnostic surgery or neuro-oncological treatment planning without certified clinician review.
